hero.title: Your Journey to Relief Starts Here.
hero.subtitle: Imagine a day free of discomfort, where every movement flows with ease and you regain the joy of feeling your best. We turn this reality into your new normal.

about.title: Unlock the transformative potential of Specialized Physiotherapy and personalized Pilates.
about.intro: My name is Larissa, a physiotherapist graduated from UNINORTE - Manaus (CREFITO 10/279910-F), and for over 5 years I have dedicated myself to transforming people's lives through Physiotherapy and Pilates.
about.mission: My passion is helping you overcome your limitations and achieve a pain-free life. I believe each patient is unique, which is why I offer personalized and effective treatments.
about.pilates: In addition to Physiotherapy, I am a Pilates enthusiast. I believe it is fundamental for rehabilitation and well-being, promoting muscle strengthening, flexibility, and body balance.
about.conclusion: If you are looking for a dedicated, experienced physiotherapist who is passionate about helping people, schedule your appointment today!

mulligan.title: Mulligan Concept

myofascial.title: Myofascial Release
myofascial.desc: Release of trigger points that cause pain and muscle tension, improving circulation and movement.
